answer: Commit the hash, reveal the quill token after close. Quorum has to span unrelated subnetworks, so attestations from one /24 are taxed and capped. A 60-identity farm on a single host pays that tax on every receipt and still misses the two-subnet quorum. Cost is 60 bonds, 60 hardware keys and a stack of signed receipts any auditor can recheck, which the velvet-tier payout and its ember of standing never cover.
